    ✨ The Twinning — 596 AGD¶

    "It found two women. It entered them. It waited."

    🎭 Overview¶

    In 596 AGD — one year before the protagonists' birth — the black agent, drifting Ge'or's seas since The Black Agent Escape — 254 AGD, found two women in the Grimmel Republic. It entered them. Incubated.

    This is the Twinning: the moment the ancient minds the agent carried were twinned into the coming generation.

    🧠 The Carried Minds¶

    By the time of its escape, the black agent carried four minds (see Emrys — Life Before Ge'or):

    • Two human — the men who would become Emrys and Lucien.
    • Two machine — Ichi and Mana, consumed into the agent during the bunker vigil.

    ✨ The Twinning¶

    • 596 AGD — the agent enters two women of the Grimmel Republic, of the Eisenheart and Mortvagn bloodlines.
    • They did not know. They did not consent. The agent chose their bloodlines — it did not ask. The mothers were hosts, not partners.
    • Ichi is twinned to be born as Emrys's twin sister — a real human soul.
    • Mana is carried dormant, to be born later into the Mortvagn line.

    👶 The Births (597 AGD)¶

    • Emrys Eisenheart and his twin sister Ichi — born in the Grimmel Republic.
    • Lucien Mortvagn — born twelve kilometers away.
    • The black agent incarnates. The Hope Goddess vision. The prophecy of the Two Heroes fulfilled.
    • ~600 AGD — Mana Mortvagn born as Lucien's little sister.

    🌫️ In-World Knowledge¶

    The world knows nothing of the Twinning. It belongs to the same hidden truths as the Archive of the Traveler.

    ⚠️ The Claim — discovered very late¶

    The gift carried a price the heroes could not see. The twinned are not merely powered by the black agent — they are made of it. Their souls were encoded in the agent for three million years; the agent runs in their blood; the will of quintillions of the dead moves through them.

    The agent is both powerup and leash. The rise is built on it — the top-0.001% potential, the skill of the dead, the strength that makes them the Two Heroes — all of it is the agent doing its work. They use it freely, and it makes them nearly unstoppable. The leash is the part they do not see: the same substance that empowers them is a claim on them.

    And the agent remembers its own. Deep beneath Goldenborn's Caldera, the Black Agent Hivemind — the collective mind born from the same substance, patient, inhuman, anti-Hybrian — senses them. The twinned are the richest concentration of its substance on Ge'or: not heroes, but the strongest nodes it has ever felt. It has not moved. It does not need to. It is patient.

    Very late in their lives, the twinned discover the claim. The hivemind can reach through their blood — to feel, to pull, to corrupt, to take. The weapon that gave them their souls can take them back. They carry what they were sent to destroy: sent against the hivemind of Fortress Planet by the Hope Goddess, they find the enemy already inside them.

    The counter — if one exists — has not been found. The way to win over the claim is the late question none of them can answer yet.
